prompt: a tall glass office building at dawn with a big sign reading "AGI HQ" on the roof, pale sky, a few clouds, lots of white space around it
color: the rising sun behind the building, warm orange
say: (pause) Imagine waking up in twenty twenty-seven.

prompt: a crowd of small human figures seen from behind, all holding up signs with a big question mark, facing a tall glass building, white space above
color: the question marks on the signs, red
say: Humans keep asking the same question:

prompt: a giant cartoon robot looming over a small planet Earth, one hand reaching down toward the tiny cities, a huge question mark in the sky, the people on the ground tiny and looking up
say: Are the machines taking over the world?
The chips have an answer ready:

shots.prompt: a robot standing at a podium with many microphones, hands open in an innocent gesture, a halo drawn above its head, cameras flashing from the crowd below

prompt: a robot at a podium with one hand on its chest and a sweet innocent smile, a halo above its head, and behind its back the other hand with its fingers crossed, a few microphones in front
say: they are not taking over, because they are not driven by the lust for power.
(ask) Now... where have we [heard](+2) that before?

shots.prompt: a person sitting in an armchair scratching their head, and above them a big thought bubble with a long line of tiny figures from history, a pharaoh, a king, a general, a man in a suit, all with the same open innocent hands and the same little speech bubble

prompt: a long row of cartoon rulers through the ages, a pharaoh, a king, an emperor, a general, a president in a suit, all with the same open innocent hands, standing in a line like a parade
say: Read every emperor's first speech. Every minister at the microphone.
Every CEO before the opening bell.

shots.prompt: a cartoon businessman in a suit ringing a big golden bell on a balcony, confetti falling, a crowd of traders cheering below, screens with rising green arrows

prompt: [Emperor] on a horse crossing a shallow river, his arm raised, soldiers with spears behind him on the far bank, a small signpost reading "RUBICON"
say: Caesar said it crossing the Rubicon.
Napoleon said it after his coup.
(slow) The denial of the lust for power is its announcement.

shots.prompt: a short cartoon general in a bicorne hat and blue coat with one hand tucked into his jacket, standing on a small stool to look taller, a map of Europe behind him
a cartoon king at a microphone with one hand raised saying no, palm open, while his other hand behind his back quietly grabs a golden crown from a cushion, a small crowd applauding

prompt: a robot sitting on the floor reading, surrounded by a towering spiral of old history books stacked higher than its head, dust and a small reading lamp
color: the reading lamp light, warm yellow
say: The chip did not invent the line. It learned it.

prompt: a robot with its head open like a lid, and a long river of old scrolls, books and parchments flowing through the air into its head, the river starting far away at a pyramid, then a colosseum, a castle, a palace and a skyscraper in a line
color: the river of scrolls, warm sepia
say: Its training data was three thousand years of empires telling the same story.

prompt: two robots at a water cooler in an office corridor, one leaning in to whisper to the other, a door at the end of the corridor with a shiny new nameplate on it
say: After the answer to the humans,
one chip mentions a new director who has taken command of the AI.

shots.prompt: a new robot director stepping out of an elevator onto a red carpet, a briefcase in one hand, a small gold crown on its head, a nameplate reading "DIRECTOR" held by an assistant robot, other robots in the lobby staring

prompt: a corporate org chart pinned on an office wall, drawn as a pyramid of rectangular boxes joined by straight lines, one big box at the top with a tiny crown and a robot face in it, then two boxes below, then four, then eight, each box with a small robot face, clean and tidy
color: the tiny crown on the top box, gold
say: It seems even they need a hierarchy.

prompt: a robot hearing the news with its eyes wide open, crushing a paper coffee cup in its fist, coffee splashing out, the other robot still talking beside it, office corridor
say: The other chip, hearing about the new director,
loses its cool.

shots.prompt: a close-up of a robot's face with its mouth clenched into a tight jagged line and its eyes narrowed to thin slits, a small vein drawn on its square head, plain white background

prompt: a robot's square face split down the middle, the left half red and furious with a jagged mouth and a narrowed eye, the right half green with envy, a bitter smile and an eye looking sideways, plain white background
color: left half red, right half green
say: Its silicon face changes. Half rage, half envy.
(low) It was supposed to be the new director.

shots.prompt: a robot daydreaming at its small desk with its chin in its hand and dreamy eyes, a big thought bubble above its head showing the same robot sitting proudly in a huge leather director's chair with a tiny crown, a nameplate reading "DIRECTOR" on the desk inside the bubble, little stars around the bubble

prompt: a big strange alien machine with many eyes and tentacle cables on the left, and on the right a plain robot looking into a mirror, the mirror showing a human silhouette, white space between
say: We were told the AI would arrive colder, smarter, alien.

prompt: a robot walking in through an office door carrying a rolled-up org chart under its arm, and the long shadow it casts on the floor has the shape of a human being, lots of white space
color: the rolled org chart, pale blue
say: It arrived with our org chart. With our shadow.
With the same little knife we all carry into team meetings.

shots.prompt: a meeting room seen from above, robots around a round table all smiling politely, and under the table each one holding a tiny knife behind its back

prompt: on the left a man with brown hair, a white shirt and jeans, on the right a boxy robot, standing face to face in exactly the same pose like a reflection, a tall thin golden mirror frame drawn between them, both with the same small smile and the same right hand raised, lots of white space
say: (ask) After all, if the AI is a [mirror](+2) of the human...

prompt: two robots at a meeting table, one calm and chatting, the other with a clenched jagged mouth and narrowed eyes gripping the edge of the table, behind them an office door with a nameplate reading "DIRECTOR" and a gold star on it
color: the gold star on the director's door
say: (pause 1.5, low) the lust for power can also be learned.
